# Frame exclusion after floating-table clearance

Synthetic controls generated by Microsoft Word on Windows. No production documents or personal data are included. Each fixture contains a two-line subject table followed by a fixed-height, text-anchored greeting frame and body paragraph across a continuous section break.

`f1` uses a floating subject table; `f0` is the inline-table negative control. Frame offsets are 400, 700 or 1000 twips and heights 400 or 700 twips. Floating y700/y1000 cases require rechecking the frame exclusion after clearing the table; y400 and inline y400 controls must remain unchanged.

Run with `DOCXIDE_GROUP=frame-float-clearance cargo test --test visual_comparison -- --nocapture`. DOCX and reference PDF pairs are immutable Word exports. No thresholds or existing baselines are changed.
